text:
{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "strings and BLOBs are capped at 1 billion bytes",
      "claim_text": "The default maximum size for strings and BLOBs is 1 billion bytes.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails"},
        {"sid": "P0.S0", "rel": "entails"}
      ],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Default macro value is 1 billion; macro defines max string/BLOB bytes."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "tables can have at most 2000 columns",
      "claim_text": "The default maximum number of columns in a table is 2000.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states default SQLITE_MAX_COLUMN is 2000."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "well-normalized schemas rarely need more than about 100",
      "claim_text": "Well-normalized schemas rarely need more than about 100 columns.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage says experienced designers argue well-normalized DB never needs more than 100 columns."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Queries with joins are limited to 64 tables",
      "claim_text": "SQLite does not support joins containing more than 64 tables.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of passage."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "this limit cannot be raised or lowered",
      "claim_text": "The join table limit cannot be raised or lowered.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states no mechanism to raise or lower the join limit."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "because the query planner uses one-bit-per-table bitmaps internally",
      "claim_text": "The join limit arises because the SQLite code generator uses bitmaps with one bit per join-table.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage gives this as the reason for the limit."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Expression trees can nest up to 1000 levels deep by default",
      "claim_text": "The default maximum expression tree depth is 1000.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states current default value is 1000."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "0 means unlimited",
      "claim_text": "If SQLITE_MAX_EXPR_DEPTH is 0, no limit is enforced.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "compound SELECT statements can have at most 500 terms",
      "claim_text": "The default maximum number of terms in a compound SELECT is 500.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states SQLITE_MAX_COMPOUND_SELECT defaults to 500."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "real-world compound selects almost never exceed single digits",
      "claim_text": "In practice, the number of terms in a compound SELECT almost never exceeds single digits.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S3", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Host parameter numbers are limited to 999 in versions before 3.32.0",
      "claim_text": "SQLITE_MAX_VARIABLE_NUMBER defaults to 999 for SQLite versions prior to 3.32.0.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S3", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states default 999 for versions prior to 3.32.0."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "32766 in later versions",
      "claim_text": "SQLITE_MAX_VARIABLE_NUMBER defaults to 32766 for SQLite versions after 3.32.0.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S3", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states default 32766 for versions after 3.32.0."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "SQLite allocates space for every parameter between 1 and the highest number used",
      "claim_text": "SQLite allocates space to hold all host parameters between 1 and the largest host parameter number used.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a stray ?1000000000 could otherwise demand gigabytes of memory",
      "claim_text": "An SQL statement containing host parameter ?1000000000 would require gigabytes of storage.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states this exact example."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "You can ATTACH up to 10 databases to a single connection by default",
      "claim_text": "The default maximum number of simultaneously attached databases is 10.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states SQLITE_MAX_ATTACHED is set to 10 by default."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "with a hard ceiling of 125",
      "claim_text": "The maximum number of attached databases cannot be increased above 125.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "defaults to 4294967294 pages since version 3.45.0",
      "claim_text": "SQLITE_MAX_PAGE_COUNT defaults to 4294967294 since version 3.45.0.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P8.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states since 3.45.0, 4294967294 is the default."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "yielding roughly 17.5 terabytes with the default 4096-byte page size",
      "claim_text": "With the default page size of 4096 bytes, the maximum database size is about 17.5 terabytes.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P8.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "up to about 281 terabytes with the maximum 65536-byte pages",
      "claim_text": "With the maximum page size of 65536 bytes, the database file can grow to about 281 terabytes.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P8.S3", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Most of these limits (except the join limit) can be adjusted at compile time",
      "claim_text": "Most of these limits except the join limit can be adjusted at compile time.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": false,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P0.S2", "rel": "entails"},
        {"sid": "P1.S1", "rel": "entails"},
        {"sid": "P3.S1", "rel": "entails"}
      ],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passages show some limits adjustable at compile time and join limit not; 'most' is a generalization not fully supported."
    }
  ]
}
